environment: Ubuntu WSL, Go 1.26.0, PostgreSQL 16.14, isolated migration-backed schema per run

checks.name: concurrent_one_time_reset
checks.detail: Two concurrent repository calls for one synthetic reset digest: one succeeds, one reports consumed/unavailable. The new password hash, used marker, session and voice lease revocation, SESSION_REVOKED reason, one SFU outbox row and one audit event were confirmed; an unrelated user's session remained active. Repeated 20 times.

checks.name: backend_suite
checks.detail: go test -json -count=1 ./... with both PostgreSQL test URL variables: 666 passed, 0 skipped, 0 failed; focused go vet passed.

checks.name: remaining_qa02_matrix
checks.detail: End-to-end reset link completion, recovery, role refresh, topology revision, voice transfer and WebSocket revocation races remain.

limitations: This is a repository race using a synthetic replacement hash; HTTP link handling and password hashing are tested separately, not as one integrated reset flow.
SFU outbox insertion proves revocation is queued, not that a connected media client was removed; QA-10 covers that gate.
